title: Story premise ENT037: The Pencil-Shaving Spiral
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (miniature adventure). Hook: The only staircase is trying to uncurl. Takeaway/theme: A support can turn a floppy material into a usable shape.
description: A miniature courier must climb to a desk shelf after the ladder is removed. A curled pencil shaving keeps springing open underfoot, so the courier winds it around a thick marker to make a spiral path, delivers the parcel, and leaves the new path for the next traveler.
